intent.goal: Select a documentation strategy for clarifying Agentflow managed-pattern authoring guidance.
acceptance_criteria: The workflow validates against the current v1 contract.
The strategy selection compares authored candidates against one shared criteria set.
The selected strategy packet includes ranking, rejection rationale, diversity evidence, and residual uncertainty.

intent.goal: Select the best documentation strategy for clarifying when graph authors should choose managed patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Every candidate strategy includes implementation outline, validation plan, risks, assumptions, and cited evidence.
The selected strategy is ready for a later implementation node to execute without rediscovering the decision.
Rejected strategies include clear rationale tied to the shared criteria.
constraints: Do not recommend changes outside managed-pattern authoring guidance.

context.name: managed_patterns_doc
context.what: Product documentation that defines managed-pattern behavior and public artifacts.
context.why: Candidate strategies must fit the current product guidance.

context.name: authoring_managed_patterns_skill
context.what: Authoring skill guidance for choosing and using managed patterns.
context.why: Candidate strategies must keep docs and authoring guidance aligned.

intent.goal: Develop a minimal documentation patch strategy that adds only the missing managed-pattern selection guidance.
acceptance_criteria: The strategy identifies the smallest doc and skill surfaces to update.
The strategy explains focused validation and review evidence.
The strategy records risks and assumptions about reader understanding.

intent.goal: Develop a decision-matrix strategy that adds a compact comparison table for managed-pattern selection.
acceptance_criteria: The strategy defines the table dimensions and where they belong.
The strategy explains how the table avoids duplicating existing pattern pages.
The strategy records risks, assumptions, and validation evidence.
constraints: Do not propose a standalone framework outside existing docs.

criteria.rubric: The candidate fits existing Agentflow documentation structure and authoring skill conventions.
The candidate helps graph authors choose the right managed pattern without adding unnecessary concepts.
The candidate has a focused validation path using existing docs, skill, and graph validation checks.

args: const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const input=process.env.AGENTFLOW_CONTEXT_SELECTION; const outputDir=process.env.AGENTFLOW_OUTPUT_DIR; const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(input,'utf8')); const ranking=Array.isArray(data.ranking)?data.ranking:[]; const rejected=Array.isArray(data.rejected)?data.rejected:[]; const selected=data.selected&&typeof data.selected==='object'?data.selected:{}; const passed=data.schema_version===1&&data.status==='selected'&&typeof data.selected_candidate_id==='string'&&data.selected_candidate_id.length>0&&selected.id===data.selected_candidate_id&&ranking.length>=2&&rejected.length>=1&&data.diversity&&data.diversity.passed===true; const result={passed,status:data.status,selected_candidate_id:data.selected_candidate_id,ranking_count:ranking.length,rejected_count:rejected.length}; if (outputDir) { fs.mkdirSync(outputDir,{recursive:true}); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outputDir,'verification.json'), JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n'); } console.log(JSON.stringify(result)); process.exit(passed?0:1);

intent.goal: Verify the strategy selection packet is complete enough for later implementation.
acceptance_criteria: The selected packet matches the selected candidate id.
The packet includes ranking, rejected candidates, and passing diversity evidence.

context.name: selection
context.what: Strategy selection packet from the candidate comparison.
context.why: The verification command checks that the selected strategy evidence is complete enough for later implementation.

verification.description: Structured result for the strategy selection artifact verification.
